'''Vlaçan Umber''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Vindalian]] [[Baron/Legends|baron]], art connoisseur, and the patron of the [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] [[light sculptor]] [[Ves Volette]]. He was one of the initial suspects in Volette's murder, but was exonerated. He became shocked when it was revealed by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] that Volette had been murdered by the Umber family's [[Umber 3PO unit|protocol droid]], who only wished to heal the suffering of Umber's wife, [[Kirma Umber|Kirma]].

Umber was a Vindalian noble, and generally kept to himself.
